description: This file defines the interface IPlaybackService for a media playback service within the Rialto server component. It declares virtual methods for controlling playback states, configuring maximum playback counts, retrieving shared memory, and accessing related services like media pipeline and web audio player services.

classes.name: IPlaybackService
classes.description: An interface class for controlling media playback, providing methods to switch activity states, configure maximum counts, and access related services.

methods.name: setMaxPlaybacks
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of concurrent playbacks.

methods.name: setMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of Web Audio players.

methods.name: setClientDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the display name for the client.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the service is active.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Retrieves the shared memory file descriptor and size.

methods.name: getMaxPlaybacks
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of playbacks.

methods.name: getMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of Web Audio players.

methods.name: getShmBuffer
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: getMediaPipelineService
methods.description: Provides access to the media pipeline service.

methods.name: getWebAudioPlayerService
methods.description: Provides access to the Web Audio player service.
